scope: Small public-source demonstration; not a clinical benchmark or consensus release

studies.context: LI160 extract 900 mg/day for 10 days; digoxin 0.25 mg/day; healthy volunteers
studies.summary: Repeated dosing reduced digoxin exposure. The first-dose comparison did not show a statistically significant change.
studies.ratio_basis: Day-15 hypericum/placebo group means: 12.9 / 17.2; parallel-group comparison, not an individual baseline ratio
studies.review_status: source-checked demonstration extraction; independent dual review pending

studies.context: Extract 600 mg/day for 14 days; renal transplant patients; cyclosporine doses adjusted
studies.summary: Dose-corrected cyclosporine exposure fell during supplementation; dose adjustments were required.
studies.ratio_basis: Reciprocal of reported baseline/coadministration geometric mean ratio 1.83
studies.review_status: source-checked demonstration extraction; independent dual review pending

studies.design: Randomized supplementation sequence with washout and positive controls
studies.context: St John's wort 300 mg three times daily for 14 days; healthy volunteers
studies.summary: Digoxin exposure decreased following supplementation. No numeric ratio was extracted from the abstract.
studies.review_status: source-checked demonstration extraction; independent dual review pending

studies.design: Randomized supplementation sequence with washout and positive controls
studies.context: Echinacea 267 mg three times daily for 14 days; healthy volunteers
studies.summary: The study reported no effect on digoxin pharmacokinetics for the tested preparation. This does not establish equivalence or safety for all preparations.
studies.review_status: source-checked demonstration extraction; independent dual review pending

St John's wort.mechanism_note: Hyperforin activates PXR and can induce CYP3A4 expression. The inhibition model cannot predict this induction.
St John's wort.structure_note: GtoPdb canonical tautomer; source notes tautomer differences across databases.

Turmeric.mechanism_note: One constituent is modeled; its estimate does not represent the whole preparation.

Echinacea.mechanism_note: No single constituent selected for this preparation. Assay prediction is unavailable.
